name: Akshay Kumar Reddy Nanobolu
headline: Software engineer building enterprise Salesforce products, full-stack apps and AI agents
summary: I'm a product-oriented software engineer who works across enterprise Salesforce engineering, full-stack development and applied AI. I enjoy tracing hard problems to their root cause, optimizing resource-heavy systems and turning complex logic into reusable, maintainable code.
careerDirection: I want to grow into an engineer who designs architectures, solves hard technical constraints and brings AI into practical software products.

engineering principles.title: Research before building
engineering principles.summary: I understand how a system really behaves before choosing a solution.

engineering principles.title: Fix the root cause
engineering principles.summary: I investigate the underlying cause of a problem and implement solutions that prevent it from recurring.

engineering principles.title: Design for reuse
engineering principles.summary: I prefer clear abstractions that other developers can use without knowing the internals.

engineering principles.title: Respect resources
engineering principles.summary: I watch memory, queries and processing cost, and ask whether a workload belongs inside a constrained environment.

engineering principles.title: Protect existing behavior
engineering principles.summary: I consider backward compatibility and regression risk whenever shared code changes.

engineering principles.title: Security by design
engineering principles.summary: I consider security from the beginning, ensuring that data access, permissions and system boundaries are protected by design.

values.description: A 160-day LeetCode streak wasn't built on motivation. It was built on a habit that works even on the days I'd rather skip.
I believe there is always room to grow. I continuously challenge myself, learn from every experience and refine my skills to become better at what I do.

values.tagline: If it's mine, it's on me.
values.description: I take responsibility for my decisions, my work and the outcomes that follow. When something goes wrong, I focus on understanding it, addressing it and making things better.

values.tagline: Hard is part of the journey.
values.description: Difficult problems and unexpected setbacks are part of growth. I stay composed, break challenges into smaller pieces and keep working towards a solution.

values.tagline: Every setback has something to teach.
values.description: A failed submission, a broken build or an unsuccessful attempt is an opportunity to understand what went wrong, learn from it and approach the next attempt wiser.
I value different perspectives, open communication and shared knowledge. Great solutions often emerge when people bring their strengths together.
I don't like accepting things at face value. I enjoy understanding how things work, questioning assumptions and exploring ideas beyond what I already know.
